ticket.title: Adopt models-catalog 0.1.0 in sawhorse: catalog-backed limits, streaming flag, wire reasoning
ticket.description:
UNBLOCKED: models-catalog 0.1.0 is published (GB-218). Full plan in .gaugeblock/storypole/plans/GB-217.md; summary of scope below.

DEPENDENCY LINE, deliberately narrow: models-catalog = { version = "0.1.0", default-features = false, features = ["cline", "bundled"] }. The default feature set pulls reqwest 0.13 + tokio + directories, and sawhorse is on reqwest 0.12 - enabling defaults would compile a second HTTP stack for something sawhorse already has, plus an ambient ~/.cache path and a ~/.cline settings reader. With defaults off the crate is a pure synchronous parser/lookup table, which is what a hermetic gate needs. Freshness comes from running the crate CLI out of band, not from sawhorse doing HTTP.

FIVE BEHAVIOUR CHANGES, in order:
1. Feature-gated CatalogSource (Bundled + Null impls) so existing tests stay hermetic; precedence config override > catalog > default via ModelOverrides.
2. Replace my hand-rolled output_budget (window - prompt - 64, no cap) with resolve_gateway_max_output_tokens (32k cap, 1024 reserve, reasoning floor).
3. requires_streaming: send stream:true on the FIRST call for a flagged model instead of discovering the 500 and retrying - GB-214 retry stays as the net for unflagged models. This directly retires a wasted round-trip we measured.
4. Reasoning effort via to_wire_reasoning_params instead of the three hand-encoded keys (reasoning, reasoning_effort, thinking) captured in the GB-214 dump - payload goes from 3 encodings to 1.
5. sawhorse models reports real limits and billing tier from catalog membership, fixing the configured_is_advertised false negative that came from cross-checking GET /models only.

THEN RETIRE DATA: delete CLINE_PASS_MODELS and scripts/refresh-cline-pass.sh, delegate is_pass_model to the catalog.

GAP EXPOSED: gaugeblock-contracts ReasoningEffort lacks XHigh and Max, so xhigh cannot be requested until the contract grows - filed as GB-221 because it is a wire-contract change with its own miter contracts gate.
acceptance_criteria: sawhorse-core builds with and without the catalog feature; existing tests unchanged
Output budget delegates to resolve_gateway_max_output_tokens, with tests for known and unknown models
A model flagged requires_streaming makes zero non-streamed calls
A fill payload emits exactly one reasoning encoding
sawhorse models reports the configured cline-pass id as advertised and pass-eligible

verification_receipt.summary: All eight steps done. 1-2 ddca648 catalog source with config-override precedence behind an off-by-default feature; 3 fa01c42 gateway budget delegated to resolve_gateway_max_output_tokens with exact-expectation tests; 4 40463bc/1ef157e/6985283 requires_streaming - measured that every cline-pass model is flagged, enforced so a constrained model never sends the doomed non-streamed request (the live fill lost its transport failure the same hour); 5 b186f2f/a3509ae one canonical reasoning field instead of three, verified by request dump; 5b 6589cec per-protocol wire shapes via to_wire_reasoning_params, measured changing reasoning_effort=medium into the DeepSeek thinking toggle; 6+7 2566d7e reads eligibility and existence from the catalog, deleting the hand-maintained fifteen-id list and turning configured_is_advertised from false to true for the configured id; 8 d43044e/5c146a9 document that metadata belongs to the crate and policy to the suite. One guard added where the crate is wrong for us: effort None short-circuits to Disabled because the clamp turns it into thinking enabled, which is what GB-206/GB-212 disabled to protect the budget. Gates: clippy -D warnings, fmt and tests green with the catalog feature on and off throughout.

completed_items: Steps 1-2 landed (sawhorse ddca648). catalog::resolve_limits merges config override > catalog > nothing, field by field, behind a catalog feature that is off by default. CatalogSource trait with NullSource (offline/tests) and BundledSource (models-catalog compile-time snapshot, no network/runtime/disk). Dependency pinned default-features = false, features = [cline, bundled] to avoid pulling reqwest 0.13 + tokio + directories alongside sawhorse on 0.12. Measured against the real snapshot: cline-pass/deepseek-v4.1-flash -> context 1,000,000; the -1017 id -> 1,048,576; default_reasoning_effort None so config stays authoritative; output saturates at u16::MAX because InferenceRequest::max_tokens is u16. Gate green both ways: 21 tests feature-off, 26 feature-on, clippy -D warnings clean.
remaining_items: Steps 3-8: delegate ModelLimits::output_budget to resolve_gateway_max_output_tokens (32k cap, 1024 reserve, reasoning floor) keeping our arithmetic only as the no-catalog fallback; requires_streaming so a flagged model makes zero non-streamed calls; to_wire_reasoning_params replacing the three hand-encoded reasoning keys; sawhorse models reporting real limits/billing tier and fixing configured_is_advertised; delete CLINE_PASS_MODELS + scripts/refresh-cline-pass.sh; update CONTRACTS.md and common/ARCHITECTURE.md section 4.
handoff.last_error_or_blocker: None. Note for step 3: ModelLimits.max_output_tokens is u16 while the catalog advertises 384k, so the gateway budget must be computed from the catalog u64, not from the clamped ModelLimits value.

completed_items: Steps 1-3 landed. ddca648: CatalogSource with NullSource + BundledSource behind an off-by-default catalog feature, config override > catalog > nothing resolved field by field. fa01c42: catalog::output_budget asks the catalog first (32,000 cap, 1,024 reserve, explicit ContextOverflowError reported and logged then delegated to fallback) and keeps GB-215s min(cap, window - prompt - 64) only as the unknown-model fallback; it computes from the crates u64 limit rather than our clamped u16. Verified with exact expectations against the real bundled snapshot: prompt 1000 -> 32000, request 50000 -> 50000, prompt window-2024 -> 1000, prompt == window -> None. Gates: 27 tests feature-off, 29 feature-on, clippy and fmt clean both ways.
remaining_items: Steps 4-8: requires_streaming so a flagged model makes zero non-streamed calls; to_wire_reasoning_params replacing the three hand-encoded reasoning keys; sawhorse models reporting real limits and billing tier plus fixing configured_is_advertised; delete CLINE_PASS_MODELS and scripts/refresh-cline-pass.sh; update CONTRACTS.md and common/ARCHITECTURE.md section 4. Also still open: nothing in joiner calls catalog::output_budget yet - fill_options::resolve uses ModelLimits::output_budget directly, so wiring it through (and enabling the catalog feature in joiner-cli, or passing a source into FillOptions) is the follow-up that makes step 3 pay off end to end.

completed_items: Steps 1-4 of 8 landed. ddca648 catalog source + precedence; fa01c42 gateway budget delegated to the crate with exact-expectation tests; 40463bc requires_streaming decision, which measured that EVERY cline-pass model in the bundled snapshot is flagged, including the id the suite calls; 1ef157e provider streams first when flagged, with create_provider_with + router wiring behind the feature; 6985283 joiner-cli enables the catalog so it is live. LIVE OBSERVATION: the same fill that failed all session now returns no transport error and no retry - the 500 empty response content class is gone. It now fails honestly with compile: unresolved import unicode_segmentation, filed as GB-224.
remaining_items: Steps 5-8: to_wire_reasoning_params replacing the three hand-encoded reasoning keys; sawhorse models reporting real limits/billing tier and fixing configured_is_advertised; delete CLINE_PASS_MODELS and scripts/refresh-cline-pass.sh; CONTRACTS.md + common/ARCHITECTURE.md section 4. Also: nothing in joiner calls catalog::output_budget yet (fill_options::resolve still uses ModelLimits::output_budget), so step 3 is not observable end to end even though the catalog is now loaded.
handoff.last_error_or_blocker: None, but note the causal revision: GB-214 was recorded as an intermittent gateway fault with 3-of-5 failure rates. The catalog says these models require streaming, so the failing request was never going to succeed. GB-214 verification text should be read with that correction.

completed_items: Steps 1-7 done, step 5 in reduced form. ddca648 catalog source + config-override precedence; fa01c42 gateway budget delegated with exact-expectation tests; 40463bc + 1ef157e + 6985283 requires_streaming measured (every cline-pass model is flagged) and enforced so a constrained model streams on the first call; b186f2f wire_token; a3509ae payload emits ONE reasoning field instead of three, verified by live dump (reasoning_effort alone); 2566d7e deletes the hand-maintained ClinePass list and reads eligibility plus model existence from the catalog, which turns configured_is_advertised from false to true for the configured id.
remaining_items: Step 5b: per-protocol wire reasoning params via to_wire_reasoning_params, which needs the catalog threaded into build_payload (Anthropic budgets, GLM toggles, Gemini budgets cannot be expressed by a single reasoning_effort field). Step 8: CONTRACTS.md and common/ARCHITECTURE.md section 4 need to state that model metadata is owned by models-catalog while the suite keeps policy, and that sawhorse models reports catalog-backed eligibility.
handoff.last_error_or_blocker: None. Two deliberate scope notes: step 5 was done as the canonical single field rather than the full per-protocol form, and CLINE_PASS_DOCS survives as a documentation pointer while CLINE_PASS_MODELS and the capture date are deleted.

task.title: Discover model limits and the ClinePass set from models.dev and the recommended feed
task.description:
Limits are currently declared by hand (GB-215) because the OpenAI-compatible surface exposes none: /models returns bare ids, /models/{id} is 404, and `usage` reports cost not ceiling.

But the catalog is discoverable elsewhere, confirmed by measurement:
- https://models.dev/api.json answers 200 in ~1.1s, 5.9MB, 233 providers, and carries limit.context / limit.input / limit.output plus reasoning_options per model. It includes a `cline-pass` provider with 18 entries (kimi-k3, glm-5.3, deepseek-v4.1-flash, qwen3.8-max, minimax-m3, ...).
- https://api.cline.bot/api/v1/ai/cline/recommended-models answers 200 with 3.4KB of {recommended, free, clinePass, clineCloud}; clinePass has 15 ids including the exact wire id we use, cline-pass/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017, which is NOT in /models and is why `sawhorse models` reports configured_is_advertised: false.

So `sawhorse models` should cross-reference the recommended feed instead of /models alone, and a refresh path should populate context_window / max_output_tokens / reasoning_effort from models.dev, applying Clines own normalisation (max_input = min(limit.context, limit.input) else input or context or 128_000; max_tokens = limit.output or 4096; clamp effort to the advertised reasoning_options). Rust crates that already parse the models.dev schema exist (ai-model-directory-router, models-dev-rs) - evaluate before hand-rolling a parser.

Measured values to reconcile against the current config: cline-pass/deepseek-v4.1-flash is 1M context / 384k output / efforts [none, low, high, max], so the declared 32k output is a deliberate cap rather than the model limit, and `medium` is not an advertised effort (the gateway clamps rather than rejects - verified, all six values answer 200).

events.title: Adopt the external models-catalog crate in sawhorse (blocked on GB-218)
events.description:
BLOCKED ON GB-218 (external crate). Do not hand-roll a models.dev parser in the meantime: that work is being built once, outside the meta-harness, and duplicating it here would create two drifting schemas.

DECISION: adopt a published crate rather than implement discovery in-tree. Placement is OUTSIDE the meta-harness so catalog churn does not tax suite releases and so the 10-repository canon, outfeed install --all and the sibling [patch.crates-io] mapping stay untouched.

WHY IT PAYS: three fragile pieces disappear. cline_pass.rs is a hardcoded const of 15 ids whose own doc admits the set moves, scripts/refresh-cline-pass.sh scrapes a docs page markdown to refresh it, and models.rs parses only GET /models (bare ids) - which is why sawhorse models reported configured_is_advertised false for cline-pass/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017, a model that is in fact pass-eligible.

INTEGRATION SHAPE when GB-218 lands:
1. Feature-gated catalog backend in sawhorse-core; ModelLimits resolves as CONFIG OVERRIDE > catalog > default. The declared context_window / max_output_tokens / reasoning_effort stay as the outage path and are not removed - that is what GB-215 bought.
2. Delete CLINE_PASS_MODELS and scripts/refresh-cline-pass.sh; is_pass_model delegates to the crate curated lookup.
3. sawhorse models reports real context_window, max_output_tokens and effort options, and fixes the advertised/pass-eligible false negative by consulting the curated feed as well as /models.
4. Tests pin a small fixture with no network; one ignored live parity test.
5. benchwork model panel can reuse the same crate afterwards, which argues for the neutral models-catalog name with Cline specifics as the opt-in part.

MEASURED NUMBERS TO RECONCILE: cline-pass/deepseek-v4.1-flash is 1M context / 384k output / efforts [none, low, high, max]. The declared 32k output is a deliberate cap, not the model limit, and medium is not an advertised effort - the gateway clamps rather than rejects, verified across all six values.
